values.dx_1: Right knee strain with chondromalacia patella
values.history: Veteran reports right knee pain beginning in service after a fall during a field exercise in 2011, treated conservatively. Symptoms have persisted with daily pain and stiffness. Uses ibuprofen as needed.
values.flare_ups_desc: Weekly flares lasting 1-2 days after prolonged walking; severity moderate.
values.functional_loss_desc: Difficulty with prolonged standing, squatting, and stairs.
values.functional_impact: The knee condition limits prolonged standing and walking; the Veteran can perform sedentary work with position changes.
values.remarks: Mr. Naeole (DOB 03/14/1975) reports flares worsen with cold weather.
values.opinion_rationale: The current right knee condition is at least as likely as not related to the documented in-service fall because the service treatment records show a knee injury with continued complaints at separation, and the current findings are consistent with that mechanism. There is no evidence of an intercurrent injury.
